about_the_game:
Detonation Sauce University is a school adventure game starring an ordinary student, taking you on a thrilling campus escape journey full of surprises and dangers.​

Players take on the role of a new ordinary student at "Sauce Blast High School". This seemingly everyday campus is overrun by all kinds of strange monsters after dark—"Homework Ghosts" wander in classrooms, "Exam Demons" block corridors, and "Chalk Monsters" ambush in stairwells. Without superpowers, your only basic attack method is the ketchup you carry: throw it at monsters to cover their eyes with sauce, creating a gap for your escape.​

The game’s core gameplay revolves around "Evade - Counterattack - Escape": each level corresponds to a different campus area (classroom, library, gym, etc.). You need to move nimbly to avoid monster encirclement, find ketchup supply points, seize the moment to throw sauce and distract monsters, then escape through hidden safe routes (such as the passage behind lockers, the secret door in the stairwell). As long as you successfully get rid of the monsters in the current area, you can clear the level, unlock the next campus danger, and gradually uncover the secret behind the frequent appearance of monsters on campus.

  • First you have to find the weapon, otherwise you can't move.

  • Earn stars by writing quests.Destroy objects by throwing them at the target.

  • Fruit, junk, and even creatures can also be picked up for your ammo.

  • When you arrive at your destination, you can go through the customs.

  • No matter in the school or in the neighborhood there may be bullies, dogs and so on, be careful yo.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game contains strong language and extreme violence.
